Game Overview

Pirate Bombs is a adventure title where dive into a thrilling escapade with Jack the pirate. Navigate treacherous waters teeming with killer green whales, leap to confront your foes, and collect bombs. With rising tides adding urgency, your swift moves and strategic jumps are your lifeline to success in this high-seas adventure!
